stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G015】分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范；【G020】语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP019】机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 分词短语（现在分词与过去分词）作后置定语与状语及悬垂修饰防范
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 分词短语能将冗长的从句浓缩为紧凑的后置定语或状语；但句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语完全一致，绝不可产生悬垂修饰（Dangling Modifier）。
rules: 后置分词定语：records exceeding the limit (= that exceed...)；predictions compared with ground-truth labels (= that are compared...)。
句首分词状语主语一致铁律：Using a 48-step look-back window, the model reduces MSE（the model 可以 use window；但不能写 *Using a 48-step window, the MSE decreases，因为 MSE 不会自己 use window！）。
examples: Records exceeding the stated size limit were excluded.
Compared with earlier studies, this study used a larger sample.
Halving the sampling interval doubles the sampling frequency.
common_errors: 悬垂分词：*Training on synthetic data, the generalization error remained high（应改为 When the model was trained on synthetic data, ... 或 Training on synthetic data left the model with high generalization error）。

grammar_instruction.name: 语态的语篇决策：基于研究对象、旧信息前置与施事责任的主动/被动选择
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 破除“被动语态一定比主动语态更学术”的迷思。语态选择服务于：(1) 维持句间话题链连贯（把上句提到的受事对象作为本句被动主语，满足 Given-before-New），(2) 明确谁对设计决策或核验承担责任。
rules: 当描述标准化数据清洗、传感器部署或客观流程，且受事对象是段落主题时，选用被动语态（The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis）。
当阐述本文核心创新设计、范围限定决策或强调多名标注者独立操作时，选用主动语态（We confine the analysis to...; Two analysts analysed the data independently; The algorithm exploits the sparsity of the matrix）。
examples: Passive for topic continuity: The predictions are compared with ground-truth labels that were checked by two annotators.
Active for clear methodological agency: We reformulate the constrained problem as an equivalent optimization problem.
common_errors: 通篇机械使用被动语态导致语句冗长、施事责任模糊（如分不清是前人文献做的还是本文做的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 因果关系、统计相关、混杂（Confounding）与反事实（Counterfactual）表达边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 在机器学习、流行病学、经济学与社会科学写作中，必须严格区分预测准确率/统计相关（prediction accuracy / correlation / association）与因果效应（causal effect / causality）。
rules: 观察性关联用 correlate with, be associated with, coincide with；不能仅凭高预测精度或滞后项相关性（lagged correlation）声称确立了 causality。
讨论因果识别时，准确使用 confounding（混杂因素）、counterfactual outcome（反事实结局）、exogenous（外生的，需写明与扰动项关系）及 disentangle A from B（分离交织效应）。
examples: Predictive accuracy alone cannot establish causality.
Unmeasured confounding may bias an estimated treatment effect.
For a treated individual, the outcome under no treatment is a counterfactual outcome.
common_errors: 在观察性数据或纯预测模型论文中滥用 cause, determine, prove a causal link。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 机器学习与时间序列：问题定义、滞后项与符号约定
expression_pattern_instruction.template: Let [symbol] denote the observation at time t; we decompose the series into [components] and evaluate predictions over horizon H.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于机器学习与时间序列论文的 Problem Formulation 部分，清晰界定输入历史窗口、滞后项（lagged observations）与预测步长。
examples: Here, N denotes the number of observations, and a lag of one step links the current state to the preceding observation.
Time-series decomposition separates a series into components such as trend, seasonality and remainder.
common_errors: 未说明采样间隔（sampling interval）就直接声称某个 lag 代表固定物理时长。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 消融实验（Ablation Study）与基线公平对比（Fair Baseline Comparison）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To disentangle the contribution of [Component A] from [Component B], we compare the full model against a conventional baseline under comparable conditions.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于实验与消融分析章节，严谨剥离各模块的独立贡献，避免只挑有利指标汇报（selective reporting）。
examples: Every proposed method should be compared against a relevant baseline under comparable conditions.
The study design aims to disentangle the effect of training from prior experience.
common_errors: 使用 unparallelled / groundbreaking 等空洞吹嘘词代替具体的消融实验差值与误差棒说明。
